The question asks for the last prose book written by W. H. Auden, who referred to Wyndham Lewis as "that lonely old volcano of the Right." The "Predicted Answer" identifies Auden as the poet but incorrectly states that his last prose book was "A Certain World: A Commonplace Book" (1970). Thus, the vital fact—the title of Auden's last prose book as "Forewords and Afterwords"—is missing from the predicted answer and replaced with an incorrect title.
